events.event_name: Coffee Project New York UES Grand Opening
events.what_it_is: Grand-opening celebration for Coffee Project New York's Upper East Side café with complimentary coffee for visitors during the morning launch window.
events.what_is_free: Free coffee for guests during the advertised grand-opening window, while available.
events.caveats: Current NYC for FREE and Average Socialite listings both give an 8–11 AM free-coffee window. Another current coffee-industry article says free coffee until noon, so this tracker uses the narrower corroborated 8–11 AM window rather than extending the giveaway. Coffee Project's official location page independently confirms the UES address and Sunday opening hours.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 8–11 AM promotional window at 1219 1st Avenue. Walk-in; no advance RSVP requirement is published in the verified event listings.

events.event_name: Howdy by Roku Times Square Coffee Truck
events.what_it_is: The New York stop of Howdy by Roku's touring coffee truck with complimentary coffee, games, photo moments and promotional prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Free coffee, games and photos; visitors can also participate for chances to win Roku/Howdy promotional prizes including a Roku Streaming Stick and trial subscription.
events.caveats: Current event coverage says the stop is free and open to students and locals. Coffee and promotional prizes are activation inventory and may be limited by supply. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, noon–5 PM at 44th St & 7th Ave in Times Square, described as in front of the former Good Morning America building.

events.address: 315C Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: Grand-opening weekend celebration for Tatte's first New York City café with complimentary specialty drinks, live illustration, a build-your-own bouquet activation and special-edition merchandise while supplies last.
events.what_is_free: Promotional Matcha and Pistachio Rose Lattes with Táche, live illustration and build-your-own bouquets are advertised as part of the public celebration; promotional items are while supplies last.
events.caveats: The current event listing says the celebration is open to the public and runs from 8 AM until promotional supplies run out. Tatte's official location page independently confirms the café/address but does not itself publish the giveaway program. Do not imply the free items are guaranteed or available all day.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20 begins at 8 AM at 315C Park Avenue South; promotional programming runs until supplies run out. No advance RSVP requirement is published.
